utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Uli, I've got some spare tools for the repair drive. Need anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. A set of screwdrivers would be helpful, if you have any to spare.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got a full set. I'll bring them over this evening.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Are we sure we have all the tools we need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Did we really check the list this time, or are we just winging it again?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I double-checked the list myself this morning — we have everything except maybe a spare fuse, which I’m picking up on the way.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey, Oren. What's this about a repair drive? I must've missed the announcement again.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! It's a community thing to fix up old appliances and stuff. I think it's next Saturday? Or maybe Sunday... I keep forgetting.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Next Saturday? Sunday? Well, either way I can probably help if it's not too early. Just text me the time when you figure it out, alright?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Ira, did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? I'm planning to help out with fixing up the old playground.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I did hear something about that! I was thinking of stopping by to help paint the benches if they need it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I'll be there fixing the swings, and I'll remind everyone about the paint job too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I'm late—did I miss anything important with the repair drive plans?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Dane! I just finished organizing some tools we might need for the drive. Got a spare wrench if anyone needs one.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good to know, Gus. What's the actual schedule looking like—are we starting tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Quinn. I've been thinking about the repair drive—do we have a clear schedule for who's bringing what tools?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Eli! I've been on top of that—I made a list and started spreading the word. Folks are bringing hammers, screwdrivers, and even a spare drill from Mrs. Chen.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, but I hope we have a plan for where to store them all. I'd hate for things to get mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, what's this about a repair drive? Need a hand with something?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I'm organizing a repair drive this weekend to fix up some broken items around the neighborhood. Could use your help if you're free.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, what time and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I heard you're helping with the repair drive for the old community center—that's awesome!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh yes, I've been keeping a list of all the tools and supplies folks are donating. Every little bit helps get that place back in shape.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: If you need me to spread the word to my other groups, just say the word—I know a few folks who might have extra tools lying around.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa, are you ready for the repair drive tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I sure am, Mara! I've got the check-in table all set up and some volunteers ready to help folks sign in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's great to hear, Rosa! I'll bring some extra tools just in case anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Bo, I've been tallying up what we've got for the repair drive. Do you know what we're still short on?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I'm not sure—I just dropped off a few old bikes and some scrap metal. Whatever else is missing, I'm sure you've got it covered.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks for the bikes and metal, Bo! But I think we could use a few more cans of paint and some sturdy rope—got any of that lying around?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rey, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? I think it's a great way to get some things fixed around here.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: A repair drive? I hadn't heard about that. What kind of things are they fixing?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, just about anything really – small appliances, furniture, even some electronics. I’ve got an old toaster I’ve been meaning to bring down.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, the repair drive? I want to make sure I understand—are we talking about the one for the community center's water pump, or something else?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, that's the one! The water pump's been acting up again, and we're rallying folks to get it fixed before the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, so it's the community center pump. Do we have the parts we need, or are we still sourcing them?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh hey, Ira, what's this about a repair drive? I'm in a bit of a rush.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, you haven't heard? The Andersons' car broke down again, and we're pooling tools and spare parts to fix it up this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, right, the Andersons. I'll see if I have a wrench lying around, but I can't promise anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Jules, I heard there's a repair drive happening soon—are you planning to bring that old lawnmower of yours?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, absolutely! That thing's been rattling like a skeleton in a tin can, so I'm hoping someone there can work some magic on it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I'll remind you on the day—we're meeting at the community center at 10 AM, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey Uli, I heard something about a repair drive—what's that again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's just a community thing to fix up some broken stuff around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, right. So like, when and where is it happening? I might've spaced on the details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Gus, I heard about the repair drive. Are you helping out with it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I'm all in! I've got a bunch of tools ready to lend out. What do you need?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's great. I might need a hand fixing my fence, actually. You got a level you could spare?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Opal, I was just going over the repair sign-up sheet — we could really use your help with the plumbing fixes this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, yes, I saw that on the sheet. I mapped out all the water shut-off valves in the neighborhood last month, so I can definitely help coordinate that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's perfect, Opal! Having someone who already knows the layout will save us so much time. Let's set you down for leading that part.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, the repair drive is still happening, right? What time do I need to drop off my tools?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, it's still on! Drop-off is from 9 to noon at my garage—I've been telling everyone on the block.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, I'll be there by 10. You're sure you have enough space for everyone's gear?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're saying the repair drive actually worked? Did you see it fix something yourself?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No, I didn't see it myself, but I heard from Mrs. Chen that her old radio started working again right after.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hmph, that's just a rumor. I'd want to see it with my own eyes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Dane, I've got my schedule all set for the repair drive next week. What time should I be at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry Eli, I usually roll in late. How about I aim for around 10am? That's when I can actually make it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 10am works for me, Dane. I'll be there sharp, so let's make sure we stick to that time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, hi Cleo! I heard there's some kind of repair drive happening around here—could you fill me in on the details?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, it's a community effort to fix up old appliances and tools folks have been holding onto. Bring anything broken to the community center Saturday morning, and we'll see if we can get it working again.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds wonderful! I have an old toaster that's been gathering dust—do you think they could take a look at it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Mara! I was just thinking about that repair drive—did we decide on a date yet, or am I mixing it up with something else?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Not yet, Oren—I was hoping we could pick a date this weekend. How does Saturday sound?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday? That sounds perfect to me—I'll mark it on my calendar before I forget again.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Leo, are you still planning to help with the repair drive this weekend? I need to coordinate the school pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm in. Saturday morning works best for me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, let's aim for 9 AM at the community center. Does that work for you?
